answer: Audit lottery: each identity locks 60 credits in the vault and draws an audit ticket. Each epoch the beacon samples one in ten; the drawn agent has ten minutes to prove its ember burns with a heartbeat keyed to its onyx ticket. Missed or copied proofs burn it; a rented ember fails, one machine cannot cover many. 1,000 fakes cost 45 each per epoch, 450,000 in ten, against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 45 only when drawn and keeps its bond.
